concepts.gloss_en: erekh apayim — 'long of anger,' i.e. patience/forbearance/long-suffering; here the spiritual quality of not being disturbed by obstacles in divine service, drawn through faith, the spirit of life (ruach), and the Land of Israel

reason_for_human: All six occurrences are vocalized identically as אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם and every paragraph uses it in the same sense — the quality of patience/long-suffering in divine service, tied to emunah, ruach/ruach-chaim, and Eretz Yisrael. The only difference between the two proposed surface forms is quotation marks, which is not a semantic distinction. No homograph or archetype/generic split is present.
